knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(gtsummary)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
```

```{r}
samples_119 = read_excel("data/all_fastq.xlsx")
samples_119_cancer = samples_119 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(tissue_type2 %in% c(
    "Papillary thyroid cancer",
        "Follicular carcinoma",                                      
        "Follicular adenocarcinoma",
        "Thyroid carcinoma",
        "Classic component", 
        "Follicular lesion",
        "Metastatic lymph node"
  ))
samples_119_normal = read_excel("data/normal_fastq.xlsx")
samples_119_thyroiditis = read_excel("data/thyroiditis_fastq.xlsx")
```

```{r}
qc_drop_cancer = c(
  "SID037",
  "SID011",
  "SID013",
  "SID024"
)

samples_119_cancer_qc_drop = samples_119_cancer %>%          # dropped 4 cancer cases --  now have 69 unique subjects
  dplyr::filter(!subject_id %in% qc_drop_cancer)
```

```{r}
final_samples_115 = rbind(
  samples_119_cancer_qc_drop,
  samples_119_normal, 
  samples_119_thyroiditis
)

smallest_tumor_drop = c("SC873744")

final_samples_114 = final_samples_115 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!sample_id %in% smallest_tumor_drop)

final_samples_113 = final_samples_114 %>% 
  dplyr::add_row(
    subject_id = "SID005",
    sample_id = "SC873736_37",
    group = "WTC Case",
    tissue_type1 = "PTC",
    tissue_type2 = "Papillary thyroid cancer",
    carcinoma_present = "yes",
    normal_present = "no",
    thyroiditis_present = "no",
    fastq = "yes",
    n_samples = "1 (mean PTC)",
    .after = 2
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!sample_id %in% c("SC873736", "SC873737"))

final_samples_112 = final_samples_113 %>% 
   dplyr::add_row(
    subject_id = "SID008",
    sample_id = "SC873739_40",
    group = "WTC Case",
    tissue_type1 = "PTC",
    tissue_type2 = "Papillary thyroid cancer",
    carcinoma_present = "yes",
    normal_present = "no",
    thyroiditis_present = "yes",
    fastq = "yes",
    n_samples = "2 (thyroiditis and mean PTC)",
    .after = 5
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!sample_id %in% c("SC873740", "SC873739"))

clinical = read_excel("data/all_samples_clinical.xlsx")

final_samples_112 = final_samples_112 %>% 
  dplyr::select(subject_id, sample_id, group, tissue_type2)

clinical = clinical %>% 
  dplyr::select(subject_id, sample_id, chron_age, sex, ms_histology, race)

final_samples_112 = merge(
  final_samples_112, 
  clinical, 
  by = c("subject_id", "sample_id")
)

```

```{r}
race_cancer = read_excel("data/no_race_samples.xlsx") %>% 
  dplyr::select(-sample_id)
race_normal = read_excel("data/no_race_samples.xlsx", sheet = 2, skip = 1)
race = rbind(race_cancer, race_normal) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(matched_race)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(subject_id, matched_race) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct(subject_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(race = matched_race)

final_samples_112 <- final_samples_112 %>%
  left_join(race, by = "subject_id", suffix = c("", "_new")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    race = coalesce(race, race_new),   # use new race only if old is NA
    race = if_else(is.na(race), "Missing", race)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-race_new)

normal_thyroid_clinical = final_samples_112 %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!tissue_type2 == "Thyroiditis") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    race_binary = case_when(
      race == "White" ~ "White",
      race == "Missing" ~ "Missing",
      is.na(race) ~ "Missing",
      TRUE ~ "Non-White"
    ),
    tissue_type_group = case_when(
      tissue_type2 == "Normal" ~ "Normal",
      TRUE ~ "Cancer"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
normal_only_df <- normal_thyroid_clinical %>%
  filter(tissue_type_group == "Normal")

normal_only_df <- normal_only_df %>%
  filter(subject_id != "SID128")

cancer_only_df <- normal_thyroid_clinical %>%
  filter(tissue_type_group == "Cancer")

cancer_only_df <- cancer_only_df %>% 
  filter(subject_id != "SID030")

normal_only_df <- normal_only_df %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group,
                   levels = c("WTC Case", "Control"))
  )

cancer_only_df <- cancer_only_df %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group,
                   levels = c("WTC Case", "Control"))
  )

normal_gtsum <- normal_only_df %>%
  dplyr::select(group, chron_age, sex, race_binary) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = group,
    statistic = list(
      chron_age ~ "{mean} ({sd})"
    ),
    digits = list(
      chron_age ~ 1
    ),
    label = list(
      chron_age ~ "Age at Diagnosis (years)",
      sex ~ "Sex, n (%)",
      race_binary ~ "Race, n (%)"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_p(
    test = list(
      chron_age ~ "t.test",
      all_categorical() ~ "fisher.test"
    )
  ) %>%
  modify_header(
    list(
      stat_1 ~ "**WTC Exposed** N = {n}",
      stat_2 ~ "**WTC Unexposed** N = {n}"
    )
  ) %>%
  bold_labels()

normal_gtsum %>%
  as_flex_table() %>%
  flextable::save_as_image(
    path = "plots/normal_gtsum.png"
  )

cancer_gtsum <- cancer_only_df %>%
  dplyr::select(group, chron_age, sex, race_binary) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = group,
    statistic = list(
      chron_age ~ "{mean} ({sd})"
    ),
    digits = list(
      chron_age ~ 1
    ),
    label = list(
      chron_age ~ "Age at Diagnosis (years)",
      sex ~ "Sex, n (%)",
      race_binary ~ "Race, n (%)"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_p(
    test = list(
      chron_age ~ "t.test",
      all_categorical() ~ "fisher.test"
    )
  ) %>%
  modify_header(
    list(
      stat_1 ~ "**WTC Exposed** N = {n}",
      stat_2 ~ "**WTC Unexposed** N = {n}"
    )
  ) %>%
  bold_labels()

```
